progress.pairing: Hold the Flic 1 button for 7 seconds, until its LED flashes. Hold it next to the Bluetooth proxy you want to use: the button works only with the proxy it is paired through. Pairing needs internet access once.

abort.no_devices_found: No Flic 1 in pairing mode was seen within a minute. Hold the button for 7 seconds and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the button through any Bluetooth proxy.
abort.pairing_failed: The button did not complete pairing. Hold it for 7 seconds and try again. If it keeps failing, take the battery out for a few seconds first. See the Home Assistant log for details.
abort.cloud_error: The Flic cloud refused the request or could not be reached.

data.auto_disconnect: Seconds of silence before the button disconnects (511 = stay connected)
data.latency: Link mode (stable = Flic timings with a 20 s link timeout, the default; proxy = keep the proxy's own settings, most robust but uses the most battery)
data.queued_timeout: Ignore presses older than this many seconds (0 = only live presses)

options.stable: Stable (up to 100 ms, 20 s link timeout)
options.normal: Flic Normal (up to 100 ms, 5 s link timeout)
options.proxy: Keep proxy settings (uses the most battery)
